title: Bound composite Dedekind certificate replay
objective: Replace generic rational multiplication-closure replay for deterministic equation-order composite Dedekind certificates with an independent exact theorem replay while preserving fail-closed corruption rejection

oracles: public corpus expected basis and discriminant

handoff.summary: Replay completed equation-order composite Dedekind certificates from their exact generator and canonical HNF instead of a generic rational multiplication table. Vector419's isolated checker falls from 23.375 seconds to 0.347 seconds; vectors 419, 007, and 104 now complete at the public boundary with frozen basis digests and discriminants.
risks: Vector420 still exceeds the 30-second public bound after its Dedekind checker falls below 0.35 seconds, so later native or global-certificate work remains a separate bottleneck.
The lane base predates integration commit e88a2069, which raises an already-exceeded arithmetic package budget; this lane does not edit the package graph.
next_steps: Integrate onto current main-1 and rerun the retained 13-case timeout tail.
Profile only the downstream stage for cases that remain bounded timeouts.
